title: An AI-native operating partner for turning priorities into governed systems of work.
summary: The AI-Native COO engagement combines operating design, research, automation, documentation, governance, and implementation support for organizations that need senior systems capacity without prematurely building a large internal function.
audience: Founders, small executive teams, research organizations, and growing institutions with complex cross-functional execution needs.
timeline: Engagements begin with a diagnostic and 30–90 day operating plan, followed by an agreed retained cadence.
fit: The organization has more priorities than operating capacity
Work spans research, legal, content, product, and partnerships
Leadership needs systems and execution rather than advice alone
evidence: Current plans, projects, meetings, and operating records
Financial, legal, technical, and staffing constraints supplied by responsible owners
methodology: Build the operating cadence and source of truth
Review performance and revise the system
assumptions: Leadership grants access to the information needed to coordinate work
Internal owners retain final authority for consequential decisions
limitations: The engagement does not replace licensed professional functions
Execution authority and capacity must be explicitly agreed
